requirement: The Symposium manifest must expose the tutor skill and a `lab` subcommand backed by an installation of the `language-lab` crate from this repository, with the installation version matching the Cargo package version.

inputs.contents:
name = "language-lab"

[[skills]]
source.path = "skills"

[[installations]]
name = "language-lab"
source = "cargo"
crate = "language-lab"
version = "0.1.0"
git = "https://github.com/nikomatsakis/language-lab"
executable = "language-lab"

[subcommand.lab]
description = "Read and update language-learning memory and review dates"
command = "language-lab"

"""Verify the distributed Cargo archive, skill version, and Symposium wiring."""
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re
import subprocess
import tarfile
import tempfile
import unittest

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]


class PackageTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_archive_builds_and_versions_match(self):
        metadata = json.loads(subprocess.check_output(
            ["cargo", "metadata", "--locked", "--offline", "--no-deps",
             "--format-version", "1", "--manifest-path", str(ROOT / "Cargo.toml")],
            text=True,
        ))
        package = next(p for p in metadata["packages"] if p["name"] == "language-lab")
        subprocess.run(["cargo", "package", "-p", "language-lab", "--locked",
                        "--offline", "--allow-dirty", "--no-verify"], cwd=ROOT, check=True)
        archive = Path(metadata["target_directory"]) / "package" / (
            "language-lab-" + package["version"] + ".crate")
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="language-lab-package-") as directory:
            with tarfile.open(archive) as bundle:
                for entry in bundle.getmembers():
                    self.assertTrue(entry.isfile() or entry.isdir())
                    self.assertFalse(Path(entry.name).is_absolute())
                    self.assertNotIn("..", Path(entry.name).parts)
                bundle.extractall(directory)
            extracted = Path(directory) / ("language-lab-" + package["version"])
            for path in ["Cargo.lock", "src/main.rs", "src/lib.rs",
                         "SYMPOSIUM.toml", "skills/language-lab/SKILL.md"]:
                self.assertTrue((extracted / path).is_file(), path)
            self.assertFalse((extracted / "language-lab-ci").exists())
            self.assertFalse((extracted / ".agents").exists())
            skill = (extracted / "skills/language-lab/SKILL.md").read_text()
            expected = re.search(r"The expected CLI version is \*\*([^*]+)\*\*", skill)
            self.assertIsNotNone(expected)
            self.assertEqual(expected.group(1), package["version"])
            subprocess.run(["cargo", "build", "--locked", "--offline"],
                           cwd=extracted, check=True, capture_output=True)
            binary = extracted / "target/debug/language-lab"
            self.assertEqual(subprocess.check_output([str(binary), "--version"], text=True),
                             "language-lab " + package["version"] + "\n")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

justification: Scenarios: shipped skill directory, runnable subcommand backed by a declared installation, correct crate/repository/executable, synchronized version, and standalone package contents/build. The TOML integration test resolves lab to its named installation and checks these values against Cargo.toml. The archive test verifies skill and manifest inclusion and independently builds and runs the CLI. cargo agents plugin validate SYMPOSIUM.toml --no-check-crates passes using installed Symposium 0.5.1 in an isolated SYMPOSIUM_HOME. This validates the package definition without enabling it or claiming a remote Git install before the changes are pushed.
